name: Simeon
bio: Simeon is the second son of Jacob and Leah; Leah named him because "the LORD hath heard that I was hated" (Genesis 29:33). Fierce in temperament alongside his brother Levi, after their sister Dinah was violated by Shechem, the two tricked the men of Shechem's city into being circumcised, then while they were still in pain, slaughtered every male in the city in revenge (Genesis 34). In his deathbed blessing, Jacob specifically noted that Simeon and Levi's "weapons of violence are in their habitations," and because of their fierce anger and cruel violence, declared that their descendants would be scattered throughout Israel (Genesis 49:5-7) — a prophecy later fulfilled as the tribe of Levi was dispersed to serve as priests throughout Israel's cities, while the tribe of Simeon gradually diminished and was absorbed into Judah.
